title: Search History Privacy Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Professional template to request deletion or access to your search history data from companies. Protect your privacy with this ready-to-use letter.
description: A comprehensive letter template to formally request access to, correction of, or deletion of your search history data from search engines and online platforms. Helps you exercise your privacy rights effectively.

sections.heading: Subject Line and Introduction
sections.content:
Subject: Privacy Rights Request - Search History Data

Dear Privacy Officer,

I am writing to exercise my privacy rights regarding the search history data you have collected about me. As a user of your services, I am requesting information about and/or action regarding my personal data under applicable privacy laws including CCPA, GDPR, and other relevant regulations.

sections.heading: Account Identification
sections.content:
My account details are as follows:
- Account Username/Email: [Your Account Email]
- Account ID (if known): [Account ID]
- Approximate account creation date: [Date]
- Additional identifying information: [Any other relevant details]

Please use this information to locate my account and associated search history data in your systems.

sections.heading: Specific Request
sections.content:
I am hereby requesting the following action regarding my search history data:

☐ Access: Please provide me with a copy of all search history data you have collected and stored about me, including but not limited to search queries, timestamps, IP addresses, and associated metadata.

☐ Deletion: Please permanently delete all search history data associated with my account, including search queries, related metadata, and any derived insights or profiles.

☐ Correction: Please correct the following inaccurate information in my search history data: [Specify details]

☐ Portability: Please provide my search history data in a portable, machine-readable format.

sections.heading: Legal Basis and Timeline
sections.content:
This request is made under my rights as a data subject under applicable privacy laws. I understand that you have 30-45 days (depending on jurisdiction) to respond to this request. If you require additional time or information to process this request, please contact me promptly.

If you cannot fulfill this request, please provide a detailed explanation of why the request cannot be completed and information about any appeal process available to me.

sections.heading: Identity Verification
sections.content: I understand you may need to verify my identity before processing this request. I am prepared to provide reasonable proof of identity. Please let me know what documentation you require, and I will provide it promptly while ensuring the security of my personal information.

sections.heading: Contact Information and Closing
sections.content:
Please acknowledge receipt of this request and provide me with a reference number for tracking purposes. You may contact me at [Your Email] or [Your Phone Number] if you need any additional information.

I look forward to your prompt response and cooperation in this matter.

Sincerely,

[Your Signature]
[Your Printed Name]
[Date]
